When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong?

Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives — or dies — on social media.

This isn’t just another shop simulator.

Stock shelves, manage supply, set prices, hire staff, expand your liquor store, and build a profitable alcohol empire.

Every day the market changes — track trends, predict demand, buy low, sell high, or risk losing everything.

Holidays, festivals, inspections, and market rumors constantly change demand — adapt fast or watch your business collapse.

Your reputation shapes your business — customers react to your prices, behavior, and decisions online, affecting traffic, premium buyers, events, and even police inspections.

Run a legal business or break every rule for bigger profits — but one inspection could destroy everything.

You can drink your own stock, but alcohol affects your judgment, reputation, and performance — turning a simple liquor business into a dangerous balancing act.

Expand your store, unlock premium suppliers, dominate the market, and become the city’s top liquor seller — or lose everything to greed, risk, and temptation.

BUILD. SCOUT. ADAPT.

Build a four-hero team, scout each opponent’s lineup, and adapt your 2×2 formation to counter it.

FORGE POWERFUL WEAPONS

Forge basic gear into something far more powerful and push your build beyond its limits.

EQUIP. ENCHANT. SCALE.

Equip your heroes, enchant their gear, and squeeze more power out of every slot.

FIGHT OTHER PLAYERS’ BUILDS

Send your squad into PvP against saved builds from other players — and see how your strategy holds up.

THE FLOOR IS MISSING. YOUR DELIVERY IS STILL DUE.

You're a tiny wind-up courier with a portable floor kit. Cross a broken factory solo or with three friends.

Need a crew? Find co-op partners on our Discord (link in the sidebar →).

  • 1–4 player online co-op, or solo

  • Carry, throw and place floor panels. Your crew shares only four.

  • Get the Clockheart out while RIVET hunts its carrier

  • 5 factory wings, each with a boss showdown

BRING YOUR OWN FLOOR

Throw panels across gaps, build a crossing, then recover them for the next one.

Spring floors launch longer jumps; grip floors resist crosswinds and brake the moving line. Time your steps around transfer decks, conveyors, turbines and presses.

FOUR PANELS, ONE CREW

Pass a panel to a friend, and check everyone's across before taking the bridge apart.

The Clockheart powers shutters: dock it, build your route, then retrieve it before reserve power runs out. You can carry a panel or the power unit, so divide the work.

WATCH FOR RIVET

RIVET tracks the Clockheart carrier. Distract her with loose floor, interrupt her with a press, or get clear of that claw.

At each gate, bait her strikes into machinery, jump sweeps and take cover from blowers. Earn an opening, dock the Clockheart and escape together.

NO COURIER LEFT BEHIND

Miss a crossing and RIVET carries you back to your checkpoint. The clock keeps running.

Hold a shutter for a teammate, share a platform and bring everyone to the exit. Playing solo? Take a shorter route with the same floor kit and Clockheart.

OOPS.

Borrowed the floor beneath your friend? Try again. Touch a live Arc Interlock and you'll be stunned and sent back, too.

Cross Power House, Freight Exchange, Turbine Hall, Stamping Works and Core Evacuation; detour for spare fuses to buy time and safety in the next wing.

Choose your courier's colour in the storage bay, switch between first and third person, chase faster times and fill your courier passport.

2030. STRAIT OF HORUMUS.

The U.S.E. President has ordered a total blockade. Oil tankers from six countries are coming through, each following its own ridiculous doctrine.

Your assignment is simple: build the wall's defenses, combine modules, and let nobody pass.

BUILD A DEFENSE THAT IS ACTUALLY YOURS

Every tower has three module slots. Mix eight module types to create 120 builds: rapid fire, volleys, piercing shots, slows, overkill contraptions, and combinations that should probably have been denied funding.

Discover 31 named Signature Builds when the right modules meet.

MAKE THE NEXT CARD COUNT

Choose upgrade cards, reshape your loadout, and adapt to shifting threats. Range, damage, attack patterns, stealth detection, and control all compete for limited space. A strong build is not one tower—it is a plan.

TWO WAYS TO HOLD THE STRAIT

  • Story Campaign — Defend the strait against tankers across 10 stages. After each battle, the President weighs in on the results with a social media post.

  • 100-Stage Maze — Conquer a century of handcrafted routes and face a new boss every ten stages. Each milestone brings a larger, stranger threat.

DEADPAN GEOPOLITICAL SATIRE

Operation: Horumus is a parody. Its countries, leaders, events, and deliberately mangled place names are fictional exaggerations of a world that already sounds made up.

The strait is closed. Make it stay that way.

Hit the orbs. Dodge the bombs. Beat your best!

In Orb Rush VR, you're right in the middle of the action! Strike incoming orbs with your virtual hands, collect valuable bonuses, and dodge dangerous obstacles. React fast, keep moving, and push yourself to beat your high score again and again.

There's no artificial locomotion. You move within your own play space while the targets and hazards come to you. Depending on the game mode, quick reflexes, precise hits, good timing, or a sharp memory will make all the difference.

Rush – how long can you survive?


The heart of Orb Rush VR throws increasingly challenging waves of incoming orbs your way. Hit them in any order, chain rapid strikes into long combos, and send your score soaring!

But the longer you survive, the tougher it gets. Changing formations, increasing speed, dangerous bomb fields, and giant bombs will push your skills to the limit. Moving fog banks make it even harder to spot approaching hazards.

Fortunately, you've got a few tricks up your sleeve:

  • Shields protect you from mistakes.
  • Slow Time gives you precious breathing room when things get hectic.
  • Extra lives and score multipliers help you survive longer and reach higher scores.
  • Cyan-glowing fake bombs look dangerous, but hitting them rewards you with bonus points.

As you advance through the phases, the atmosphere, surroundings, and pace change. High-energy music tracks keep the action going.

Six special Rush challenges


Speed alone won't get you to the top. Practice, precision, and knowing what's coming next are just as important!

Take on six fixed Rush courses, each lasting approximately two and a half minutes. Learn their patterns, perfect your approach, and compete for a place on their dedicated permanent online leaderboards.

  • Side Switch: Move rapidly between differently arranged rows of orbs and master a fast-paced circular finale.
  • Combo Hunt: Chain hits through fan-shaped formations, spirals, and changing patterns to build the longest combos possible.
  • Bomb Slalom: Navigate dangerous bomb corridors and strike orbs in front of, between, and behind the obstacles.
  • Crystal Ascent: Follow rising fountains, wide arcs, and long hit chains while your free hand picks off extra targets.
  • Crossfire: React to crossing paths, diagonals, and shifting target groups. Bombs and fast single targets keep you moving between formations.
  • Orb Matrix: Clear staggered pairs and layered fields before taking on a sweeping finale of rising rows.

Every attempt is another chance to set a new personal best!

Daily Challenge – a new test every day


How well can you perform when everyone faces exactly the same challenge?

Every day brings a fresh Daily Challenge: an approximately five-minute Rush course with five phases and an intense finale.

Make every hit count and fight for a top spot on the dedicated daily leaderboard. Successfully complete the course to earn extra points for any lives, shields, and slow-time charges you have left.

Seven game modes, different skills


Beyond Rush, six additional game modes test more than just your reaction speed. Accuracy, concentration, and memory all have their place.

  • Combo: Hit numbered orbs in the correct order and earn time bonuses for clean hit streaks.
  • Hardcore: One wrong hit resets your progress and timer for the current level.
  • Arcade: Mistakes add precious seconds to your time, but you can keep playing.
  • Reveal: Only the next three target orbs are visible. Can you keep up with the sequence?
  • Recall: Memorize the positions of numbered orbs, then find the right targets from memory.
  • Swarm: Clear dense orb formations in any order, collect bonuses, and dodge bombs.

Rush and Combo are available from the start. Unlock the remaining modes by completing levels.

Learn, improve, and chase records


New to Rush? The optional interactive tutorial lets you practice combos, shields, slow time, and bonus items without affecting your records or achievements.

Single levels: In unlocked numbered modes, jump straight into a completed level or your next available level. Improve personal level times and continue unlocking progress. Online time leaderboards remain reserved for complete 5-, 10-, and 15-level runs.

Rush phase training: Practice phases you have already reached, either individually or continuously up to your highest reached phase. Choose your starting shield and slow-time reserves. Training does not count towards records, achievements, or new phase unlocks.

Once you're ready, the real competition begins! Improve your personal bests, earn Steam achievements, and challenge other players on daily and global all-time leaderboards.

Compare your Rush high score or compete for the fastest times across 5, 10, and 15-level runs.

An arena that changes around you


Different skies, shifting lighting, crystalline orbs, and energetic music keep the experience fresh. Detailed gloves, sculpted platforms, and three-dimensional bonus items bring the arena to life.

Choose from three graphics presets – Reduced, Standard, and Enhanced – to match your preferences and hardware. Optional 2× or 4× anti-aliasing helps reduce distracting shimmering edges.

Music, sound effects, and controller haptics can be adjusted separately. On supported controllers, you can also choose between the available buttons for shields and slow time.

Active VR – no artificial locomotion


Orb Rush VR is designed for active standing play. Targets come to you while you reach, strike, and physically dodge incoming hazards. You can calibrate the game to your height.

Required play space: At least 2.00 × 1.50 m of clear space. Gameplay is blocked below this minimum. For more comfortable movement, reaching, and dodging, we recommend 2.00 × 2.00 m.

Ready for the next wave?

Orbisphere is a cozy idle-arcade game about a small astronaut, named Orbi, with a big job: collect stardust to wake a sleeping station and find your way home.

Ride the orbit - the active loop

Drift through space, using your jetpack to speed up. Orbi can't change directions with his jetpack. Instead, utilise the gravitational pull of planets to change directions and slingshot your way through space. Collect stardust as you go and return to your station to upgrade your equipment. 

Feed the machines - the idle loop

Stardust feeds machine. Machines feed upgrades. Use the lab, 3D printer, solar wings and drone dock. Then let your OrbiBot collect stardust while you're afk. 

Upgrades let Orbi reach further into space in hopes of finding his way home.

Risk & Reward

Stardust is plentiful in the asteroid belt, but so are the hazards. What you gather only counts once you carry it home.

Build your garden oasis

Past the hazardous asteroid belt there is a light that shouldn't be there. Follow it and you might find something worth planting. 

Beware the wormholes!

  • Hands-on arcade sling-shotting with real momentum

  • A deepening idle economy that runs while you're away

  • Machines, gardens and upgrade trees to wake one by one

  • A quiet, lonely corner of space to make your own

  • Mini-games to boost your economy

  • Full controller support

  • No internet required, no accounts, no in-app purchases

A space navigation simulation centered around asteroid deflection, where spacecraft are guided by shaping their orbits, turning small adjustments into precise encounters.

Features

  • Various missions featuring asteroid interception and redirection, satellite deployment, mining, and transport

  • Easy to learn yet hard to master, combining simple controls with physics-inspired orbital mechanics

  • Different spacecraft, including missiles, rockets, and satellites, each with a distinct purpose

  • Moments of deep satisfaction from perfectly executed orbital maneuvers

  • Relaxed atmospheric soundtrack that evolves with gameplay

Content Creator Information

All music and assets are original and safe for streaming, recording, and monetization.

Your supply chain determines the army you get.

OrderlyWorld is a strategy game about building production routes, drawing a random elemental army, and adapting that army to survive escalating enemy waves.

Before each mission, choose a finite crew pool of Water, Fire, and Lightning heroes. On the island, build production chains that generate resources for drawing heroes from your chosen pool. You will not get the same army every time, so every mission asks you to work with the heroes that appear.

BUILD YOUR CREW

Choose which heroes can enter the draw pool. Each copy uses one crew pick. Bring duplicates to support growth, or choose more identities for a wider range of combinations.

MAKE LOGISTICS MATTER

Deeper production opens higher-quality draws, giving you access to rarer heroes. The chain you build determines which parts of your army can take shape before the next wave lands.

ADAPT TO EVERY DRAW

Deploy, reposition, recall, and target with the heroes you receive. Change your formation as new enemies expose its weaknesses.

COMBINE ELEMENTS

Water controls and delays. Fire delivers ranged burst damage. Lightning manipulates space and mobility. Focus on one element or mix them to answer different threats.

REBUILD AND TRY AGAIN

A failed defense reveals a new plan: change the crew pool, rebuild the supply chain, and try a different combination.

OrderlyWorld is in active development. All store footage and screenshots show real gameplay.

ORE-Legacy is a retro CRT-style space mining incremental game about building an orbital industry from almost nothing. You begin with a lonely station, an old mining laser and a huge debt.

Mine asteroids, recover ore, expand your station, automate fleets, salvage wrecks, siphon stars, and slowly transform a failing operation into a sprawling extraction network.

Start mining ORE with your laser

Build ships to mine for you

Observe celestial bodies to gather SCIENCE

Use SCIENCE to buy upgrades

And more...

  • Retro green-screen CRT visual style

  • Incremental space mining and automation

  • Station modules, upgrades, and expanding industry

  • Mining frigates, salvage ships, drone carriers, siphoners, transports, and more

  • Asteroids, wrecks, stars, planets, nebulae, and deep-space logistics

  • Science generation through observation and probes

  • Salvage systems, Helion harvesting, and hyperlane construction

  • Corporate debt, quotas, taxation, and prestige-style progression

Build your business. Explore the solar system. Find your home on Mars.

Oreship Stellar Frontier combines economic management, idle progression, directly controlled spaceflight, and hands-on exploration on Mars. Take the helm of your freighter, drive your buggy across the desert, or develop a network of production, trade, and transport.

Your first contracts and modest resource discoveries open up new possibilities: better vehicles, your own space stations, research expeditions to distant star systems, and major construction projects on the Red Planet.

Three starting paths determine how your story begins.

  • Manager: Begin with a small mining business. Extract resources, invest in ships and production facilities, and use automation and offline progression to expand your economy.

  • Solar System: Start at Sol Station, buy your first freighter, and earn credits through trading, contracts, and your own journeys. Decide where your next flight will take you.

  • Mars: Begin with a house, a garage, and your buggy. Explore your surroundings, sell your discoveries, and earn the settlements’ trust. Later, work toward access to the solar system and your first spaceship.

Your choice determines your starting point. Additional areas of the game unlock as you progress, while your existing achievements and progress carry over.

Discover Mars through the eyes of your astronaut.

A 20 × 20-kilometer Mars map awaits, with vast dune fields, towering rock formations, settlements, and deep cave systems. Leave your vehicle behind, explore on foot, and use tools, scanners, and a jetpack to search for interesting locations and valuable discoveries beyond the roads.

  • Collect rocks, meteorites, gemstones, and rare finds.

  • Analyze samples in the laboratory and complete research and photography assignments.

  • Explore underground passages and vast chambers filled with glowing crystals.

  • Discover abandoned expedition reports and unusual locations.

  • Take on deliveries and repair jobs to earn new equipment.

  • Experience changing times of day, dust storms, and meteorite impacts.

Get to know six settlements and earn their respect.

Aurora, Kepler, Ares, Horizont, Ferrum, and Meridian offer contracts, trading opportunities, and their own reputation rewards. Help the residents, deliver supplies, and complete tasks to improve your standing.

As your reputation grows, you gain access to more opportunities, useful tools, special items, and unusual vehicles. Some rewards make your work easier, while others open up entirely new ways to spend your time on Mars.

Turn resource discoveries into a working industry.

Build extraction and production facilities, process materials, and organize transport between your operations and the settlements. Supply factories, operate an oxygen plant, or return materials to the production cycle through your recycling center.

  • Plan automated deliveries and deploy cargo cassette transporters and trucks.

  • Build tracks, depots, and freight warehouses for your MAGNETAR trains.

  • Connect locations with your own train routes and manage the flow of goods.

  • Expand facilities, storage, and vehicles to meet your production needs.

  • Deliver construction materials for major projects and watch them take shape.

Work toward a green dome settlement such as VIRIDIA or construct the ZENIT space elevator. Once completed, its panoramic cabin takes you to the observation deck at an altitude of 50 kilometers.

Take the controls and discover new ways to travel.

Drive your buggy over dunes, transport heavy cargo, or explore the landscape with flying and hover vehicles. Upgrade your vehicles and choose the right one for your next undertaking.

Put your driving skills to the test in buggy time trials, single races, and Grand Prix events against computer-controlled opponents. Away from the racetrack, more unusual activities await: run a mobile food truck or unlock the DÜNENGEIST, a hovering pirate ship with dark sails.

Your next contract awaits in the solar system.

Fly your freighter yourself or use the autopilot. Dock at space stations, buy and sell goods, and keep an eye on fuel, cargo, and your ship’s condition.

Expand your fleet with specialized ships for mining, freight, passenger transport, and research. Take on transport and salvage missions, investigate asteroids and comets, or supply special construction projects. Your own space stations, equipped with modules for energy, storage, processing, and research, give your business further opportunities to grow.

Research takes you beyond the solar system.

Discover distant star systems through the expedition system and organize their exploration. Send probes to unknown celestial bodies, equip rovers, ocean drones, and ring skimmers, and have their discoveries analyzed in the laboratory.

Investigate mysterious anomalies, decipher relics, and expand your collections and archives. As you progress, you unlock further technologies, extraction opportunities, and projects for terraforming and colonies.

Your own home awaits between journeys.

Furnish your house on Mars with furniture, lighting, and decorations. Display your discoveries and awards, and arrange each room to suit your taste.

You decide how to spend your next session: on an expedition into the depths, delivering goods to the next settlement, expanding your economy, or enjoying a few quiet moments decorating your home. In Manager mode, offline progression also supports your business between visits.

Origins TCG is a fast-paced competitive card game with limited edition cards. Outsmart opponents, collect iconic characters like Mulan & Robin Hood, and trade to build the ultimate collection.

Every turn is both players' turn. Outplay your rivals in ~7 minutes. Battle in 3 lanes with unique conditions so no two games feel the same.

Rip packs. Trade dupes. Collect digital graded cards. Every pack is full of limited edition legends with marketplace value.

The best competitive games start with a level playing field.

That’s why every Origins player can earn all the cards they need to build competitive decks, for free. Spending money will never unlock stronger cards or give you an advantage in gameplay.

Collect rare, hand-drawn cosmetic variants of your favorite cards, then trade them with other players in the marketplace. Rip limited-edition collectibles, chase legendary pulls, and discover grail cards prized for their artistry and rarity, not their gameplay power.

Both players move at once. Simultaneous turns means no more waiting for your opponent to take their turn. Draw, predict, and battle across three dynamic locations. Outplay your opponent in ~7 minutes.


Every match draws from a pool of 100+ rotating locations that reshape the board and demand a unique strategy. Easy to learn, difficult to master.

Origins is an original world inspired by history's most iconic characters like Robin Hood, Queen of Hearts, & Winnie-the-Pooh. Earth got their names right and everything else wrong. Now the portals are open, and only the worthy may enter.

OTHERHOLD is a fantasy voxel sandbox action RPG where exploration, combat, and building are all part of the same adventure.

Your life in your old world has ended. Without knowing how or why, you awaken once more in a completely unfamiliar place: a world of magic, creatures, ancient civilizations, and dangers you have yet to understand.

You have been given a second life. And this new world is far from safe.

Explore freely, gather resources, grow stronger, venture into dangerous dungeons, and build a place to call your own.

BUILD AND DEFEND

Gather resources and shape the world around you to build bases, fortifications, and defenses. Prepare yourself against creatures and enemy forces that threaten everything you have built.

FORGE YOUR OWN HERO

Develop your character, acquire new equipment, and experiment with different weapons, abilities, and fighting styles as you face increasingly dangerous enemies.

Fight up close, attack from a distance, or wield extraordinary powers to overcome anything standing in your way.

EXPLORE A VOXEL FANTASY WORLD

Travel through forests, mountains, settlements, structures, and territories inhabited by different creatures and civilizations.

Explore from the ground or take to the skies and discover what lies beyond your home.

VENTURE INTO DUNGEONS

Discover dangerous places filled with enemies, rewards, and challenges. Enter prepared, defeat the creatures guarding them, and return with resources and equipment that will help you grow stronger.

SURVIVE THE INVASIONS

Your enemies will not always wait for you to find them.

Fortify your position, prepare your defenses, and fight alongside your allies when the dangers of the world arrive at your doorstep.

YOUR SECOND LIFE. YOUR FORTRESS. YOUR STORY.

Explore. Fight. Build. Grow stronger.

Your life ended once.

This world may have given you a second chance.

If you can save it.

■ Game Introduction

A catastrophic collapse split the ancient immortal world into countless fragments drifting through the empty void. Your starting island erodes endlessly, and only the Core of Shards can halt its annihilation. To survive, you must scout remote isles, open void portals, defeat island lords and absorb their territory and resources. As you gather more world shards, the hidden truths behind the apocalypse gradually surface, pushing you toward the ultimate goal: mending the fractured heaven and earth and reforging a whole immortal world.

■ Core Gameplay Features

Real-Time Five-Element Combat
Master the spells of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth, enhanced by Lightning, Ice and Wind variants. Each cultivator can only wield the element of their nature, but with six freely combinable skill slots — area attacks, single-target executions, imprisoning fields and more — you forge your own combat style.

Nayin-Blessed Disciples System
Recruit over thirty types of disciples inspired by traditional Nayin five-element astrology, each with innate traits and unique passive talents. The hero is immortal thanks to the Core of Shards, but a disciple who falls in battle won't return on their own — only a rare resurrection pill can bring them back, making every expedition a life-or-death choice.

Customizable Immortal Sect Building
Develop your floating base by raising scripture pavilions, alchemy labs, forges, spirit-gathering arrays and training arenas. Build out your production chain, craft your own artifacts and elixirs, and unlock the island-steering formation to sail your entire island toward dangerous, resource-rich regions.

Four Distinct Endgame Dungeons

  • Demon Tower — climb nine layers where beasts grow stronger with every floor.

  • The Abyss — descend into the depths where the ultimate boss and world secrets await.

  • Ancient Labyrinth — a randomly generated map full of mechanisms to solve in search of ancient treasures.

  • The Grand Tournament — a 32-competitor single-elimination bracket to crown the strongest cultivator of the void and claim exclusive titles and rare rewards.

Fragment Lore Unlocking
Every conquered island unlocks a piece of the forgotten past. The memory shards scattered across the dungeons gradually piece together the truth of the apocalypse, the origin of the Core of Shards and the secret behind the fall of the ancient immortals.

■ Core Survival Pressure

The void corrodes your floating islands without pause: their stability steadily drains, and at regular intervals every island on the map resets its position. Standing still leads only to collapse — constant conquest, expansion, shard-collecting and strengthening your sect are the only way to fulfill your destiny of remaking the immortal world before everything sinks into the void.

Add Otherworld Shards to your wishlist, guard your drifting homeland, and reshape a whole new immortal world from countless scattered shards.

THE BLOCK IS YOURS. KEEP IT.

Hold the core with up to three friends. Between waves, raid the city for guns, ammo and base upgrades, then get back before the next horde hits.

OUTPOSTERS is a 1-4 player co-op third-person shooter with a rogue-lite core. Defend, scavenge, upgrade, repeat - until the block holds or it doesn't.

The outbreak took the city in a week. Everything still standing runs on one thing: the core your squad is holding. Every wave, more of them come for it. Every gap between waves, you go out and take whatever the city has left.

THE LOOP

  • Defend - The horde comes for the core. Hold the perimeter with your squad, the streets and whatever you're carrying.

  • Scavenge - Between waves the city opens up. Weapons, ammo, medkits and supply drops are out there - and so is everything that didn't join the assault.

  • Upgrade - Pull a base upgrade off a laptop in the field and carry it home: pulse cores, auto-turrets, repair drones, shield blooms, an overcharge that clears the yard.

  • Recall - Get back to the core before the next wave lands. Take damage on the way and the teleport cancels.

FIVE OPERATORS

Every operator has their own stat line and three abilities. Pick the one that covers what your squad is missing.

  • VERA - Soldier. Heavy weapons, suppressing fire and a combat signal that buffs everyone standing near her.

  • DOCTOR - Chemist. Toxic clouds, antidote fields, and stamina that simply does not run out.

  • NYX - Assassin. Shadow step, execution marks, lethal from behind - and one mistake from the floor.

  • KAIN - Wanderer. Grapple shot, recon scans, no bad matchup and no great one either.

  • MURDAR - Survivor. Firm stance, second wind, and the kind of endurance that turns a wipe into a save.

NEARLY FORTY WEAPONS, MOST OF THEM SCRAP

Pistols, dual pistols, shotguns, rifles, a sniper rifle, a flamethrower, a chainsaw and a rocket launcher if the city is feeling generous - plus katanas, fire axes, sledgehammers, nailed bats, crowbars and pipe wrenches. Grenades, molotovs and pipe bombs for when the yard fills up. Melee is a real combo chain, not a panic button. Everything you find goes on the wheel, and everything on the wheel runs out.

THE INFECTED HAVE JOBS

Runners rush you. Spitters shell the core from range. Leapers come over cover. Bombers close the distance and detonate. Screamers call the block down on you. Bloaters leave poison where they die, Armored Riots do not care about your pistol - and every fourth wave, something much bigger arrives.

WHAT'S IN THE GAME

  • Sixteen waves and four bosses, solo or 1-4 player online co-op over Steam.

  • Five difficulties from Normal to Apocalypse, and curses on top for squads that want it worse.

  • Endless Siege after the last boss, with a Steam leaderboard.

  • Weapons that unlock as you play, goals for every operator, and cosmetics earned on the higher difficulties.

  • Ten languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.

The free demo is still up: the first eight waves and two bosses. If the block held for you there, the other eight are waiting.

The books aren't the only things that should have been returned.

It's the year 2000, and you're the new night crew at Bellweather Library. Serve the patrons, keep the place running, and save toward a library of your own. It sounds like an ordinary job. Then the phone rings, something moves in the stacks, and the rules start making sense.

Keep the library running

Check library cards, find requested books, process loans and returns, and tackle the shift's chores. Shelve, dust, water plants, stamp, and mend books before closing up. Some patrons are funny. Some are difficult. Some should not be here.

Find out what happened here

Follow notes, calls, messages, and unsettling encounters into Bellweather's past. Watch the security cameras and listen carefully: a routine shift can turn into a chase. The story builds across the nights, with quiet tension, sudden scares, and a library that becomes harder to trust.

Work alone or bring a crew

Play offline in Solo Shift, or share the duties with up to four players in online co-op. Proximity voice chat lets you hear your coworkers nearby. Night-by-night saves let you return for the next shift.

Put your wages to work

Anyone in the crew can spend the shared wallet in the end-of-night Store. Buy useful upgrades for watering, stamping, and book repair, or decorate the desks with collectible figures. Purchases leave your separate library savings untouched.

A longer story in development

The full game is being developed as a 14-night campaign. The free demo covers the first four nights; later nights are still in development.

Over rafted! is a co-op multiplayer game for up to four players, where you navigate a raft across an endless ocean. Share the workload as you steer, fish, gather supplies, and make repairs—and keep your raft from falling apart when no one is looking!

No two voyages go according to plan! Shifting winds and currents, treacherous waters, volcanic eruptions, and all kinds of sea creatures will turn life aboard your raft into chaos. Communicate with your crew and work together to overcome one disaster after another.

Your food supply will slowly run out as you sail. Catch fish to keep hunger at bay, gather materials drifting across the ocean, and repair your battered raft. Deciding who steers, who finds food, and who gathers supplies is the key to survival—and those roles may need to change at a moment’s notice.

Reach a port, and you can use the materials you have collected to upgrade your raft and equipment. Expanding your raft gives your crew more options, but it also leaves you with more to protect. Join forces with your friends, venture into an ever-changing ocean, and see how far your crew can make it!

You are welcome to create gameplay videos and livestream this game. Please include a link to this game's Steam store page in your video or stream description.

Overseas Wars is a real-time strategy game in which you’ll build and defend your base before setting out to conquer a fantasy universe where galleons, pirates, and feathered chieftains coexist. Through a story-driven campaign, you’ll discover the stories of characters in a new bustling world. You can also enjoy custom games to build and command powerful armies or perfect your combat tactics.

Whether you're a newcomer to the genre or a seasoned veteran of multitasking, Overseas Wars invites you to (re)discover many of the fundamentals of real-time strategy games, as well as exclusives mechanics, in a fun way.

Plan your strategy

Will you choose to establish a colony and ensure its survival in the face of the dangers of a new, unexplored land? Or are you there to claim the primacy of your tribe on its territory? Perhaps you prefer to recruit all kinds of pirates and outlaws to succeed in a lawless world?

Whatever path you choose, you will in most cases have to build and organize your base.

  • To achieve this, each faction has a variety of buildings and exclusive units offering their own advantages. For example, settlers can improve their buildings to make them more efficient and employ more workers, while pirates can bring their recruits directly by sea or through the nearest escape tunnel. The Panhutti natives, for their part, can adapt techniques of their warriors by constructing different totems.

  • Many development options will be available to you and you will have to choose where to invest your resources among research buildings, resource producing buildings and unit training buildings in order to recruit and improve the units corresponding to the strategy of your choice.

  • It is to be expected that your enemies will certainly not let you calmly prepare their defeat and that they will attempt multiple attacks to defeat you. To counter those you can build defenses, ranging from a simple observation post to a reinforced cannon tower, including traps and walls.

Explore new lands

  • In Overseas Wars you will explore rich territories where certain more or less hidden and more or less defended resources await whoever comes along. Along the way, you’ll discover areas ideal for large-scale battles and guerrilla warfare, as well as vantage points from where you can observe.

  • You will also come across points of interest and larger structures offering their owners valuable resources and new tactical or strategic opportunities. For example, stables will allow you to train riders, trading posts will offer you the possibility of exchanging resources and inns will provide places to rest your units before the upcoming battle.

  • You can obviously explore these places with a sentry troop or an outstanding tracker, or you can use the exploration tools inherent to your faction. Indeed, each faction has its own intelligence and interference system. Keep in mind that once you've discovered the enemy's base, you'll be able to monitor it and take some actions. Spies, thieves, and dirty tricks will all be part of the game.

Take on the battle

Battlefields in Overseas Wars can take many forms. You can besiege your opponent’s base with mortars and warships positioned far behind the front lines, witness naval battles and boarding actions, or launch devastating raids with your buffalo riders.

  • Overseas Wars will give you the chance to win battles even when you’re outnumbered. First, you’ll need thorough preparation : well-rested units, motivated by the sermons of a zealous inquisitor, will fight more effectively than cursed or sick units.
    You’ll also need a sound strategy : by combining the tactical strengths of your units with the opportunities presented by the environment, you can gain the upper hand over your opponent.

    If that’s not enough, you can use charging, retreating, and resting tactics to chip away at enemy numbers. Be careful, however, not to get caught off guard while resting.

  • Each faction also features some more unconventional units. Whether it’s the priest, the animist, or the mermaid, each has manual and automatic abilities that influence the course of battle and thus add depth to gameplay tactics.

  • With so much happening in the heat of battle, it’s easy to miss a decisive moment. That's why Overseas Wars offers a tactical pause that you can use at any time to observe the ongoing battle and issue your next orders to your troops. Furthermore, you can replay your games to identify turning points.

Overseas Wars offers a story-driven campaign and customizable games to players looking for a real-time strategy game combining base building and tactical combat. In a universe rich in fantasy and with a deep gameplay it ensure games very different from each other.

The Only Rule of the Show: "Money is Victory!"

Welcome to <P2W: The Party Show>, the most honest and audacious party show ever created! Forget fair play—here, your "financial power" is what secures the win. As long as you have enough gold in your pockets, you can flip any desperate situation in an instant. Lacking skills? Just invest more!

Key Features

  • 🎭 True Party Chaos: A round-based survival clash with up to 8 players! Outlast the competition in a series of ever-changing minigames.

  • 🛒 Strategic Shopping Time: The P2W Shop, which opens between rounds, is the heart of the game! From powerful guns to take down your opponents to defensive items that protect you from attacks, or Gold items that help you turn Gold into even more Gold! How you invest your Gold is what separates the winners from the losers.

How to Get Rich: A Player’s Guide

  • Collect: Scrape up gold scattered across minigame maps and pass the rounds by any means necessary.

  • Purchase: Visit the shop and buy overpowered items that perfectly compensate for your "lack of skill."

  • Dominate: Overcome the unpredictable roulette, push out your rivals with the power of money, and become the star of the show!

Add <P2W: The Party Show> to your Wishlist now and seize your chance for a life-changing jackpot!

PAGANS is a fast-paced strategy card game set in a dark fantasy world inspired by Slavic mythology. Build a deck of mythic beings, cursed powers, warriors, and spirits, then take it into short tactical battles where every card play can change the outcome.

Each battle is fought over mystical locations with unique effects. You must decide where to commit your strongest cards, when to hold back, and how to use synergies between units, spells, and location effects to overcome your opponent.

Battles are designed to be quick, readable, and strategic. Instead of long matches, PAGANS focuses on tense decisions, explosive card combinations, and adapting your plan as new threats and opportunities appear.

Features include:

- Tactical PvE card battles against challenging opponents

- Deckbuilding focused on synergies, timing, and location control

- Cards inspired by Slavic folklore, pagan myth, spirits, curses, and dark fantasy

- Mystical locations that change how each battle plays out

- Short matches built around meaningful decisions rather than long grind

- A growing collection of cards to experiment with and combine

- Atmospheric fantasy presentation with a grim mythological tone

Whether you win through raw power, clever timing, sacrifice effects, control tools, or unexpected combinations, PAGANS rewards careful planning and bold plays.

Deflect. Parry. Survive.

PARRYGON is a neon arcade game about quick reactions and precise rebounds. Slide your deflector along the arena wall, send energy orbs back into the fight, and time your parries to charge them. Break a reactor core with a charged shot, dodge a laser, or turn a dangerous rebound into your next scoring opportunity. Lose a wall and the arena changes shape. Lose them all and your run is over.

Find your next challenge

  • 36 campaign missions across six zones, with changing objectives and reactor boss battles.

  • Four endless Arcade arenas with Steam leaderboards. Push your score higher and outlast the machine rivals.

  • Local Versus for 2–4 players on one computer. Share a keyboard or connect controllers, and defend your side until only one player remains.

  • Unlock six deflector loadouts and face portals, gravity wells, hostile drones, and unpredictable energy orbs.

  • Adjust the neon effects, screen shake, and visual settings. Colourblind palettes, a high-contrast mode, and remappable controls help you find a comfortable setup.

Want more? Afterlight adds 20 campaign missions across four new sectors. Aurora and Ember add cosmetic styles. These optional DLC packs are sold separately; the base game includes all 36 original campaign missions, Arcade, and Versus.

THE LAST GUY DIDN'T COME BACK

You're the new night shift worker at a pawn shop on a quiet road outside town. The guy who worked nights before you, Dale, stopped showing up a few days ago. The boss hired you fast and asked no questions.

Open the register. Turn on the lights. Wait for the door.

EVERY CUSTOMER IS A NEGOTIATION

There's no combat and no chase. There's a counter, and there are people who walk up to it.

  • Haggle. They name a price, you counter with yours. They accept, push back, or walk out.

  • Inspect. Pick the item up and turn it over before you buy. Odd seams. Engravings. Initials that don't match the person holding it.

  • Look it up. The old computer behind the counter has a price catalog and the local news. The customer waits while you check.

  • Stock the shelf. Everything you buy goes up behind you and stays there all night.

SEEMS PARANORMAL. ISN'T.

A music box plays with nobody near it. A watch that stopped ticking starts again from the wrong time. A camera prints a photo of a room you recognize.

None of it is a ghost. Every strange thing in this shop has a human explanation, and you can find it if you're paying attention. Most people won't.

THE JOB WON'T LET YOU STAY PUT

The trash needs taking out. The breaker trips. Something moves in the storage room. The boss calls to ask about the numbers and tells you to stay at the counter no matter what.

You'll leave anyway. That's the job. And every minute you spend in the back is a minute the front door is unwatched.

NOBODY IS KEEPING SCORE. THE GAME IS.

No health bar. No sanity meter. No game over. The night always ends, and how it ends depends on two things you're never shown: how much you noticed, and how well you did as you were told.

FEATURES

  • A complete 30 to 60 minute night shift, made to be finished in one sitting

  • Negotiation as the core mechanic, used for buying, for selling, and for the one conversation you'll wish you had skipped

  • Hands-on item inspection, physical shelves, a working register, a browsable shop computer

  • PSX-era low poly visuals and film grain

  • An ending that shifts with your behaviour, plus a short epilogue on what came after

Content notes: implied violence, missing person themes, sudden loud sounds, extended low-light sequences. No gore.

PEEMAN! PEEMAN!

It’s the name people cry out when all hope is lost. Now that the burden of saving the world has fallen upon you, remember: with great power comes great responsibility.

Fight back against the aliens and bring humanity the sweet relief of your life-giving stream. Who could have guessed you’d be carrying such a huge responsibility?

Before long, the streets will echo with your name again and again:

PEEMAN!

SPRAY:

This is your most important ability. Whether you’re running your operation or fighting aliens, everything depends on your superhuman stream.

PLANT:

Grow an army of combat-ready plants. What? You’re asking where the zombies are? They’ve got the day off.

MUTATE:

Upgrade your weapon and equip it with the most powerful attachments.

FIGHT:

Take down ALIENS by day and SNEILA by night! TATAKAE!

One ring. One gap.

PERIHELIA is an arcade dodger cut down to a single orbit. You hold one line around the center. Walls close in from the dark, each with one gap in it. Turn, thread it, survive the next one. That is the whole game, and it keeps asking for one more run.

Four ways to play the same ring

  • CLASSIC Pure reflex. The speed ramps up, the walls stack, nothing else gets in your way.
  • TIME The world moves only when you do. Rotation is the flow of time: turn forward to fast-forward, pull back to rewind. The music bends with you, and if you stop it sags into a drone.
  • COLOR The gap has a color, and you only pass if your ship matches it. Half a second of thought lands between you and the wall.
  • MUSIC The walls are not random. Each one sits on a beat, placed from the song's own clock, so the pattern you play is the track. Quiet sections are calm, the drop is a wave. Nothing kills you here: a miss costs energy and combo, and the song plays out.

Build the multiplier, tilt the world

Clean passes build a combo, and the combo drives a multiplier from x1 to x8. Every tier you reach shows. The play field tilts, the camera moves with it, the neon burns hotter. Break the combo and it settles back down. You can read your own run without looking at a single number.

Built to be replayed

  • A separate leaderboard for each mode, so every run counts somewhere.
  • Four difficulty levels. They change how wildly the gaps swing, not only how narrow they are.
  • Keyboard and gamepad, with prompts that match the pad you plugged in.
  • Windows and Linux, handhelds like the Steam Deck included.

Made by hand

No sprite sheets and no stock art. Every arc, ship and spark is drawn in code. The soundtrack is original, and every track carries its own beatmap and its own backdrop. The song is the level.

SURVIVE THE HORDES OF THE VOID

PHILSEQUE DIVISION is a 3D space action roguelite where you pilot powerful combat ships against ever-growing hordes of enemies.

Enter hostile zones, destroy hundreds of threats, collect experience, and install new modules during battle. Combine weapons and upgrades to create increasingly powerful builds — and be ready when the bosses arrive.

Each operation sends you into dangerous regions of space filled with different enemy forces. The longer you survive, the more intense the battle becomes.

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT DURING BATTLE

Destroy enemies, collect experience, and evolve during the mission.

Choose new modules and upgrades to transform your ship as you fight. Combine offensive and passive abilities, strengthen your systems, and discover which combinations best suit your playstyle.

Build your loadout. Grow stronger. Survive.

FACE HUNDREDS OF ENEMIES

Battles grow in scale as each operation progresses.

Face massive enemy formations, incoming projectiles, drones, war machines, and special threats while keeping your ship moving and maintaining control of the battlefield.

As your build reaches its full potential, the screen turns into a massive clash of weapons, enemies, and visual effects.

CHOOSE YOUR SHIP

Different ships offer distinct combat characteristics.

Choose the one that best fits your strategy and develop its power throughout the operation. Mobility, durability, and offensive capability can completely change the way you face the hordes.

OPERATIONS ACROSS HOSTILE REGIONS OF SPACE

Travel through different zones, each with its own identity, threats, and atmosphere.

Cross debris fields, energy storms, the remains of massive fleets, dangerous nebulae, and mysterious structures while facing enemies unique to each region.

FACE MINIBOSSES AND BOSSES

Surviving the hordes is only the beginning.

During each operation, far more powerful enemies will enter the battle. Adapt your build, keep your ship moving, and find a way to defeat minibosses and bosses before they bring your mission to an end.

JOIN THE DIVISION

Choose your ship.
Choose your mission.
Confirm the briefing.

Then enter the battle.

The operation begins now.

■ Mix the color — don’t pick it

PIGMENT LAB is a minimalist puzzle about recreating a target color with paint alone. No numeric sliders: scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land.

■ Scored by color difference

Your mix is compared to the target using perceptual color difference (ΔE) and turned straight into a score. Near-misses and perfect matches both come back as one clear number.

■ A journey through the world’s colors

66 studies at launch: master the basics in the atelier, then recreate the colors of world flags and landscapes. More collections are planned.

■ Scoop Challenge

Random color trials: read the target and rebuild it in 1, 2 or 3 scoops. How long can your streak survive sudden death?

■ Quiet by design

Comparison hints when you’re stuck, achievements to chase, and a full Japanese & English interface.

HOW FAR CAN YOU FLING A CHICKEN?

PIYO PIYO CHICKEN is a physics-based 2D arcade game about launching a chicken, keeping it airborne, and chasing your next distance record.

Set your angle and power, launch into the sky, and use Egg Bursts to keep flying when gravity starts winning.

Even the roll after landing counts toward your final distance!

LAUNCH. BURST. RIDE.

LAUNCH — Aim and let go!

Drag your chicken to set the launch angle and power, then release to send it flying.

BURST — Don't let gravity win!

Drag again in midair to use an Egg Burst. Your supply is limited, but collecting eggs and earning distance bonuses can replenish it. Nail the timing for Perfect results and build combos!

RIDE — Yes, there's a bike!

Start each flight with one bike ride ready to use. Hop on in midair, charge up, and dash forward! Collect bike pickups to replenish your rides.

EVERY FLIGHT BRINGS NEW OPPORTUNITIES

Collect Gold and Silver Eggs to fire powerful boosts.

Fly far enough and you'll encounter FEVER stretches, where twice as many eggs appear.

Egg pickups, boosts, and FEVER stretches vary from flight to flight. Watch for opportunities and decide when to spend your limited Egg Bursts.

EVERY LANDING BECOMES A POSTCARD

Once your chicken lands and rolls to a stop, your distance becomes an illustrated postcard comparing your flight to the real world.

From a 50 m swimming pool to Tokyo Tower, Mount Fuji, Mount Everest, and even a trip around the Earth.

Discover 27 postcard-style results and earn stamp-style titles across 15 tiers as you push your distance record farther.

ABOUT THE FREE DEMO

In the free demo, you can control your flight for two minutes starting from your first launch.

When time runs out, your controls stop, but the chicken continues falling naturally until it comes to rest. Your result appears after that.

You can retry as many times as you like.

The full game has no two-minute flight limit.

Try the free demo and see how far your chicken can fly!

Enjoyed it? Add PIYO PIYO CHICKEN to your wishlist to follow its release.

One more launch. One more burst. One more personal best.

Try the free demo: grow your galaxy through its first 6 billion years.

Grab planets and place them into orbit. The free demo lets you play until your galaxy reaches 6 billion years old. The full game takes your galaxy to 12 billion years, with over 60 endings to discover.

Grab a planet. Give it an orbit. Grow a galaxy.


Catch a drifting planet with your mouse, guide it toward an orbit, and let go. PLANETOON is a space puzzle game where a simple action can set a whole universe in motion.

Choose where to welcome each planet and how far to spread your orbits. Every placement helps shape the galaxy taking form before you.

Nurture life. Watch it reach for the stars.


Life can emerge on your planets, grow into civilizations, and reach out to other worlds. Some may even leave their home planet and embark on a journey of their own.

Watch the planets turn, and follow the changes unfolding in the universe you helped create.

Beyond the next orbit, something unexpected.


Planets, UFOs, black holes. A variety of celestial objects and visitors brings unexpected encounters and changes to your galaxy.

Some rare phenomena can only be found as you extend your orbits farther out. A beautiful arrangement of planets, a surprising encounter: each discovery gives you another idea to try in your next galaxy.

Over 60 endings. More space to create.

Guide your galaxy toward 12 billion years of history. How you nurture it, and the events you encounter, can lead to over 60 different endings.

Collect every ending to unlock Endless Mode, then keep building beyond 12 billion years.

A galaxy of your own, shaped by your hands.

Supported Platforms

Supports Windows and macOS.

Streaming and Gameplay Videos

Feel free to stream PLANETOON and create or share gameplay videos. Monetization is allowed. You do not need to contact us or request permission in advance. We would appreciate it if you could include a link to the game in your video or stream description.

Quarantine any intake with a pulse. Do not open the bag. Do not speak to it.

Night shift at a municipal morgue. A bell rings. Paperwork comes through the hatch. Behind the observation glass, a covered gurney rolls into the intake bay. The clerk's job is written down: confirm that the paperwork and the body are the same thing.

PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED is a gatekeeper horror game about procedure: a form that is nearly right, a weight that is nearly correct, and a rulebook that keeps adding pages you would rather not have read.

Reject any intake whose measured weight differs from the certificate by 10 kg or more.

Read the file: the death certificate and the transfer manifest. Any of the names, weights, heights, dates or signatures may be lying. Check the body with five instruments: scale, measuring tape, thermometer, UV lamp, and a stethoscope for the nights when you need to be certain. Stamp ACCEPT, QUARANTINE or REJECT. Or call your supervisor, if you still have a call left.

An intake reading 30 °C or above is not cold. What is not cold is not accepted.

Three pages of rules on your first night, more every shift. The newest page overrules the older ones, so a rule you learned on Monday can be wrong by Thursday.

Each intake is processed once. If an intake on an earlier night bore this same full name, you have not seen it.

A mistake outlasts the shift. Accept something you should have turned away and the room notices: the lights, the drawer wall, the thing you were told not to speak to. On a later night the hatch opens, the file comes through, and the name on it is one you have already processed.

Requisitions

Correct signatures pay and wrong ones do not. Between shifts you buy what the job does not provide: a UV lamp that shows marks the eye cannot, a bolt for the door that holds exactly once, a spare fuse for when the lights die. You are always short of something.

Shift record

  • Seven nights of intake, four endings to find, and an Endless Shift after the story.
  • Anomalies that stage themselves in. The first night teaches you what normal looks like so the second can take it away.
  • Endings set by how compliant you were, how curious, and how much of your humanity you were willing to file.
  • Endless Shift, unlocked when the campaign ends: the bell keeps ringing and the rulebook keeps growing after the story stops.
  • Music that escalates while you are still deciding whether anything is wrong.

Nothing is ever uncovered. The horror is paper, stamps, fluorescent tubes, a covered shape behind observation glass, and a reading you take twice because the first one cannot be right.

PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED is written and designed under one author's direction: its narrative, rules and case files are human–AI co-written and human-edited, and the design is the author's. Its background plates and props are pre-generated with AI image tools under human art direction; every document, form, stamp and interface element is drawn in code. Music and sound are produced with AI assistance under the author's direction. Nothing is generated while you play.

It has rained for 31 years. Everywhere except the Eye: a dry circle three miles wide, ringed by a standing wall of water. Wren grew up inside it, alone, talking to a bent weathervane. Then the ants built a roof over her hut.

Forecasters don't predict weather. They write it. Wren is learning.

A survivor-like with no clock

  • No timer. Distance is the difficulty: every ring you walk out from the hut is one step up. Walk further for a harder run, stay close to breathe.
  • Weapons fire on their own. You move, you pick, you choose where to stand.
  • Two or three boss areas per map. Clear them all to clear the stage. Minimap and compass point to the next one.

Write weather, not swords

  • Three schools: Atmospheric, Terrakinesis, Calamity. Calamity is not learned. It notices you.
  • 72 weapons, 46 passives, 6 and 4 slots. Hail, Tremor, Bolt, Deluge, Ashfall, Meteor.
  • Nutrition before destruction: grow a skill before you break with it, or Calamity takes an interest.

Seven books

Seven regions, each with its own ground, light and wildlife: the Eye, the Edge, the Drowned Fields, the Forest, the Highlands, the Coast, and the one place hot enough to boil rain. Ants with a queen. Beetles that drink puddles and grow. A parliament of rats whose Speaker is an office, not a person.

Runs that add up

  • Eight tiers from Drizzle to Cataclysm, twelve mutators, Endless. Thousands of distinct runs.
  • A daily forecast: one attempt, seeded by the date.
  • The Almanac: every run, won or lost, pays gems toward permanent ranks.
  • Twenty forecasters to walk out of the hut, and a hundred pets to walk out with them.

Made to be read

HD pixel art, lit in 2D. Text size, high contrast, a colour-distinct palette, screen shake and lightning toggles, four volume bars.

Everyone says "please stop the rain." The question is whether she should.

Cute toys. Heavy machinery. No survivors.


PLOW is a fast side-scrolling action roguelite about driving an armed snowplow through a possessed toy apocalypse. Hold the road against waves of corrupted Christmas toys, intercept their arcing attacks, and turn every opening into a crushing counterattack.

Weaponize the Winter


Unload a high-rate candy-cane minigun, arc globs from the Frosting Sprayer, or chain a Tinsel Tesla beam through dangerous targets. Every weapon builds heat, so reckless fire turns the mount red and forces a smoky cooldown at the worst possible moment.

Charge the PLOW


Shoot hostile candy, fruit, ornaments, and other festive ammunition out of the air to charge the PLOW meter. When it is ready, become briefly unstoppable and drive across most of the battlefield, smashing everything in your path before reversing back into position.

Build a Better Snowplow


Return to the garage between runs to equip weapons and improve the machine. Balance hull integrity with a rechargeable shield, manage weapon heat, and adapt your loadout to increasingly dangerous enemy combinations.

Fight a Toy Apocalypse


- Battle ground and flying enemy archetypes with distinct movement and animated attacks.
- Prioritize visible, destructible projectiles before they overwhelm the plow.
- Push through five escalating winter regions.
- Face Teddy Titan, a towering ground boss that patrols the battlefield and survives a direct PLOW impact.
- Play with mouse and keyboard or a gamepad.

You woke up here again today.
The white tiles blinding. An endless pool.
Somewhere far away, a song you almost remember.
And across the still water — someone is standing.

── Music × Liminal × Chase Horror ──

About the Game

Poolside Memory is a first-person chase horror set in liminal poolrooms.
Slip away from the girl who never stops following you, explore an endless pool, hide, solve puzzles, and piece together scattered memories to learn what happened in this place.

Key Features

▶ A Pool That's Never the Same Twice
Corridors, dividing walls — even where the key is hidden — the world reshapes itself every run.
Yesterday's escape route won't save you today.

▶ A Pursuer You Can Outsmart
Step into her sight, and she will come for you.
Cut a sharp corner to shake her, or wait it out inside a locker.

▶ Only the Song Remembers
When the eerie music suddenly grows clear — you are getting close to the truth.
The song drifting through this pool changes a little every time you return.
Stopped clocks, old photographs, wet tiled floors. The scenes it sings of lie sunken through this world as clues.

▶ Memory Fragments & Multiple Endings
Stopped clocks, flowers laid on the tiles, photographs of summer.
Fragments scattered through the world slowly tell this place's story.
What you gather — and where you end up — decides your ending.
But not every memory is a kind one.

Who is she — the one that keeps coming?
Why do you wake up in this pool, day after day?
And the world waiting beyond escape — is it even real?

Can you escape today's memory?

Content Warning

This game contains horror sequences involving pursuit by supernatural entities, corpse-themed characters, and sudden jump scares. Viewer discretion is advised for those sensitive to psychological horror and frightening content.

Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world


The annual calendar, classes, five-generation pedigrees, breeding after retirement — that part stays exactly as racing does.
So there is little to learn from scratch. Raise them, fight them, and climb to the top of 2,000 rivals.

The terms and rules are all in the World Glossary, written to be read.
You never have to read it. What you need is on screen.


How a year plays


A year is 48 weeks. You build a weekly training plan, pick entries from the annual calendar, and send monsters out while watching condition and fatigue. Monsters you cannot keep up with can have their training and entries handed to the Steward.
The calendar holds 576 battles a year — 72 graded and 504 condition battles.

Prize money goes into your facility. There are 17 facilities. Upgrade one and every monster raised there benefits.

Retired monsters move into breeding and carry the line forward.

The battles are worth watching


Campaign battles come in two formats: one-on-one tournaments, and battle royales where
up to eight monsters are dropped onto the same field at once and whittle each other down.
They move on their own judgement, take position, and fire off skills. During a battle, you have no input at all.

Four-way affinity — Technique beats Power beats Speed beats Intelligence beats Technique — and eight build archetypes.
Terrain, weather and lunar phase shift the maths underneath, so the same opponent can give a different result next week.

Every battle you watch is recorded, and you can go back to it.
Open a monster's stats after a battle and you can see exactly what it was doing.

What a monster is worth only shows when you raise it


Current stats are shown as numbers, almost all of them.
What is never shown: potential, growth curve, and the ceiling. The numbers on screen are not the answer.

You fight with the monster's own stats and the orders you gave beforehand — not with reflexes or execution.

Monsters you own get stronger on their own, but they get stronger still if you build the training yourself.

51 years of history are already there


Before the game begins, this world was actually simulated for 51 years.
All 3,500 monsters carry a real pedigree — born, fought and bred across those 51 years.

From year 52 on, the world is yours.
Ramvald, Harraq, Verdara and Lanhai — four continents, 99 rival owners. Some 400 monsters share your own's birth year.
They grow, compete, retire and breed without waiting for your input.

Breeding — read the match, pair them, and hope for what is born


Every pedigree falls into one of five Bloodline Types, A through E, and the offspring inherits its sire's type outright.
The moment you pick a sire on the pairing screen, the game tells you which match you are looking at.

A Nick means the parents matched well. A Double Nick means the match runs back to the grandparents — stack the effects and the bonus grows with them.
A Reverse Nick means it was born carrying a clash instead.
Bonuses and penalties are real numbers on every stat, but you do not get the answer until it is born.

Where a monster you raised ends up — and owners in the real world


Win three G1s. Win any division of the Grand Tournament, held every two years. Or lead the year in wins.
Do one of those three and the monster enters the Hall of Fame permanently.

Retired monsters go to stud. Produce a Hall of Fame offspring and the sire is promoted to Legend.
A monster that never quite won can still make its name as a father.

You can upload up to five of the monsters you raised to the Steam Workshop.
Download another owner's monster and you can fight it with your own in the Owners Cup.
Through your monsters, you are in indirect contact with owners all over the world.

Build a team of your raised monsters for 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4 battles.
The full game’s Owners Cup offers team battles alongside duels, battle royales, and tournaments. Combine stats and skills as you arrange teams A and B, then watch every monster act on its own. Follow each team’s survivors and HP alongside individual monster details, and review the results and replays. This is an offline mode using your own monsters and monsters you have downloaded.

Try the demo before you buy


  • There is no input during an auto-battle. Monsters move on their own and settle it themselves.
  • Training and entries can be delegated to the Steward, monster by monster. Training and entries are delegated separately. The Steward picks battles the way other owners do, and for delegated battles you receive only the results instead of watching. Training done by the Steward does not count toward achievement or mission training counts.
  • You cannot book a rotation weeks in advance. The calendar is laid out with rotations in mind, but entries are made week by week, by you or by the Steward.

The demo is free and runs a full in-game year, all 48 weeks.
Try the core training and auto-battle loop in the demo, delegation to the Steward included. Breeding, auctions, and the Owners Cup are features of the full game. You can download it free from this page.

Save the World with Five Elemental Princesses

Take control of five elemental princesses, cut through massive hordes of enemies, and challenge the Demon Army!

Rescue the princesses imprisoned by the Demon Army and embark on an epic adventure to save the world alongside the five elemental heroines.

Princess Vanguard is a 15-minute 2D top-down action RPG featuring fast-paced combat, intense boss battles, and satisfying character progression.

Strengthen your weapons and equipment as you battle overwhelming enemy hordes!

You grab him by the legs, drag him into an empty room and lock him in. But not everything can be done quietly. Some missions are about beating someone up, and if you walk into another prisoner's cell, he'll come at you with his fists. You can also pick a fight with any prisoner yourself.
